description.narrative: (Malawi): USAID's Tuberculosis Local Organization Network-1 (TB LON-1) activity in Malawi will support the National Tuberculosis and Leprosy Elimination Program to implement the TB National Strategic plan. TB-LON-1 will use FY 2022 funds to support: 1) implementation of a more effective shortened, fully-oral treatment regimen for drug-resistant TB (DR-TB); 2) secondment of three laboratory technologists at the national and regional TB culture labs; 3) scaling-up of new World Health Organization recommended TB molecular testing tools including GeneXpert and TrueNat which will improve access to bacterial and TB drug sensitivity testing; 4) scaling-up of the use of stool-based specimen in pediatric TB screening on Xpert or similar machine; 5) linking of diagnosed TB patients including drug-resistant TB patients to treatment; 6) implementation of TB testing quality improvement/quality assurance strategies; 7) TB screening among prison inmates; 8) leveraging of PEPFAR funding to support TB/HIV services; and 9) maintenance of a service contract for GxAlert/Aspect software; a remote cloud-based data monitoring system and automatic electronic system for Xpert diagnostic devices with real-time TB results reporting including drug resistance for timely patients care initiation. .TB LON-1 is aligned with the U.S. government's Global TB Strategy and the USAID's Global Accelerator business model to End TB that support the goal of reaching every person with TB, curing those in need of treatment, and preventing disease progression and new infections.
